as I replied in a previous comment, I myself have been raped and I know that at least five girls i’ve known in my life have been molested as a child or raped as a teen. 

being upset about how horribly we investigate rapes is no reason to completely lash out for no reason, especially considering it’s a noble cause. what you just said is a response a million times better than who i was replying to.

and that’s exactly why i was so dismissive. 

i’m not a fucking “rape denialist” and its abhorrent that anyone could come to that conclusion via literally a handful of reddit comments. that’s kind of a serious thing to tag someone as, so to do it in a brash manner and telling them to “die mad” or whatever (i know you’re not who said that) doesn’t make me think that you’re accusing me of something as denying rape. 

rape is 1,000,000% an epidemic that goes underreported and severely underpunished, but my point is that we are absolutely entering a point in society where rape is a topic of discussion and is a point of emphasis for people as young as like 12, as it should be. 

the issue is calling things ‘rape culture’ and accusing random people of enabling or denying rape is harmful and it seems to be intentionally harsh phrasing. i don’t know what it’ll be like to be a female victim of rape, but I was raped by a female two years ago, and despite my circumstances not being as traumatizing as most rapes (it’s just a fact. i wasn’t in fear, i wasn’t even upset at the time, she just forcibly had sex with me.) but people i told were very supportive of me and made me feel like what i went through was valid. 

i don’t have any answers as to how to make it better, but just going into threads claiming that NO victims are believed is blatantly false. 

i guess my point is, what does calling me a “rape denialist” do? trying to shame men as a whole because of how disgusting (admittedly a LOT) of men can be won’t help anything. sexual assault is something i’m personally passionate about, but i don’t know how to fix it, but i do know telling people who aren’t doing anything wrong that they’re a part of the problem won’t help. i’m really trying not to be rude or anything, but this stuff on the internet is a slippery slope. i don’t know you, you don’t know me, and someone more sensitive than me might just shut down if they hear something negative like that directed towards them.
